ingredients:
1 (15 ounce) container ricotta cheese
1 (10 ounce) package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
1/2 cup minced onion
1 large egg
2 teaspoons minced fresh parsley
1/2 teaspoon pepper
1/4 teaspoon garlic powder
1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese, divided
1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese, divided
1 (8 ounce) package manicotti shells
2 (26 ounce) jars spaghetti sauce
1 1/2 cups water
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F.
2. Mix ricotta, spinach, onion, egg, parsley, pepper, garlic powder, 1 cup mozzarella, and 1/4 cup Parmesan. Stuff uncooked shells.
3. Mix spaghetti sauce and water. Spread 1 cup in 9x13 dish. Arrange shells. Top with remaining sauce, mozzarella, and Parmesan.
4. Bake 45-55 minutes until tender.

ingredients:
1/2 cup butter
1 1/2 tbsp garlic powder
1 tbsp dried parsley
1 (1 lb) loaf Italian bread, sliced
1 (8 oz) pkg shredded mozzarella cheese
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F.
2. Melt butter; stir in garlic powder and parsley.
3. Brush bread slices with butter mixture.
4. Bake 10 minutes.
5. Top with mozzarella; bake 5 minutes more until melted.

ingredients:
3 anchovy fillets
2 clove garlic, chopped
1/2 lemon, juiced
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 egg yolk
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 dash Worcestershire sauce
1/4 cup olive oil
1/2 head romaine lettuce, chopped
1/4 cup grated Parmesan
2 tbsp croutons
steps:
1. Mash anchovies and garlic. Whisk in lemon juice, vinegar, mustard, yolk, Worcestershire.
2. Gradually whisk in oil until creamy. Season.
3. Toss romaine and Parmesan with dressing. Top with croutons.

ingredients:
2 tsp olive oil
1 lb guanciale (or bacon), diced
1 lb spaghetti
3 large eggs
10 tbsp Pecorino Romano cheese
Black pepper
steps:
1. Brown guanciale in oil until crispy; drain.
2. Boil spaghetti. Whisk eggs, half the cheese, and pepper.
3. Drain pasta (reserve water). Toss hot pasta with egg mixture quickly (off heat) to create sauce.
4. Stir in guanciale. Top with remaining cheese and pepper.

ingredients:
2 lb asparagus, trimmed
2 tbsp olive oil
Salt & pepper
3 tbsp balsamic vinegar
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F.
2. Toss asparagus with oil, salt, and pepper in a dish.
3. Bake 15-20 minutes until browned.
4. Drizzle with balsamic vinegar before serving.

ingredients:
2 1/2 cups bread flour
3 tsp instant yeast
1 tbsp sugar
1/2 tsp salt
3/4 tsp Italian seasoning
1 tbsp minced garlic
1/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese
1 tbsp butter, softened
1/4 cup hot water
1/2 cup milk
1 egg
TOPPING: 1/4 cup melted butter, 1/2 cup Parmesan
steps:
1. Pulse flour, yeast, sugar, salt, seasoning, garlic, 1/4 cup Parmesan, soft butter in food processor.
2. Mix hot water, milk, egg; pour into processor while running. Knead 30 sec (or by hand).
3. Rise in oiled bowl 1 hour.
4. Roll to 10x12 rectangle. Cut into strips. Brush with melted butter, sprinkle with Parmesan. Rise 30 min.
5. Bake at 375°F for 18-23 min. Broil 2-3 min to brown.

ingredients:
1 lb sweet Italian sausage
3/4 lb lean ground beef
1/2 cup minced onion
2 cloves garlic, crushed
1 (28 ounce) can crushed tomatoes
2 (6 ounce) cans tomato paste
2 (6.5 ounce) cans tomato sauce
1/2 cup water
2 tbsp white sugar
1 1/2 tsp dried basil
1/2 tsp fennel seeds
1 tsp Italian seasoning
1 tbsp salt
4 tbsp chopped fresh parsley
12 lasagna noodles
16 oz ricotta cheese
1 egg
3/4 lb mozzarella cheese, sliced
3/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese
steps:
1. Brown sausage, beef, onion, and garlic. Stir in tomatoes, pastes, sauce, water, sugar, spices. Simmer covered 1.5 hours.
2. Boil noodles 8-10 min; drain. Mix ricotta, egg, parsley, salt.
3. Spread 1.5 cups sauce in 9x13 dish. Layer 6 noodles, 1/2 ricotta mix, 1/3 mozzarella, 1.5 cups sauce, 1/4 cup Parmesan. Repeat. Top with remaining mozzarella/Parmesan.
4. Bake covered at 375°F for 25 min; uncover and bake 25 min longer. Rest 15 min.

ingredients:
6 cups all-purpose flour
2.5 pkg active dry yeast
2 cups warm water
1 tbsp salt
1 tbsp cornmeal (for pan)
1 egg white (for wash)
1 tbsp water
steps:
1. Combine 2 cups flour, yeast, salt, warm water. Beat. Stir in remaining flour.
2. Knead 8-10 min. Rise 1 hr.
3. Divide in half. Roll each into rectangle, roll up tightly, seal. Place on cornmeal-dusted sheet. Brush with egg white/water. (Rise again ~30-40 min).
4. Bake at 375°F for 20-25 min.

ingredients:
1 bag salad mix (Romaine/Iceberg)
1/2 cup croutons
2 tomatoes, quartered
1/4 cup black olives
4 pepperoncini peppers
1/4 cup red onion, sliced
1/4 cup Parmesan cheese
DRESSING: 1/2 cup mayo, 1/4 cup white vinegar, 2 tbsp oil, 2 tbsp corn syrup, garlic powder, Italian seasoning
steps:
1. Whisk dressing ingredients (mayo, vinegar, oil, syrup, spices). Chill.
2. Toss salad ingredients in a large bowl.
3. Serve with dressing on the side or tossed.

ingredients:
1 lb ground beef
1 onion, diced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 (28 oz) can crushed tomatoes
1 (15 oz) can tomato sauce
1 tsp dried oregano
1 tsp dried basil
1/2 tsp salt
1 lb spaghetti
steps:
1. Brown beef and onion; drain. Add garlic, cook 1 min.
2. Stir in crushed tomatoes, tomato sauce, oregano, basil, salt. Simmer 20 min.
3. Boil spaghetti. Serve topped with sauce.

ingredients:
3 chicken breast halves (boneless/skinless)
2 eggs, beaten
1/3 cup bread crumbs
1/2 tsp oregano
2 tbsp Parmesan
3 tbsp olive oil
3/4 cup Mozzarella cheese
SAUCE: 1 tbsp butter, garlic, onion, 1 can diced tomatoes, 1/4 cup heavy cream
steps:
1. Sauce: Sauté onion/garlic in butter. Add tomatoes, simmer 10 min. Add cream. salt/pepper.
2. Chicken: Tenderize. Dip in egg, then breadcrumb/Parmesan/oregano mix.
3. Fry chicken in oil ~5 min/side to 158°F.
4. Top with sauce and Mozzarella; heat until melted.

ingredients:
1 whole chicken
1/4 cup butter, softened
4 cloves garlic, chopped
1 tbsp fresh thyme
1 tbsp fresh rosemary
1 lemon, zested and halved
1 tsp salt
1 tsp pepper
1 tbsp olive oil
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F. Mix butter, garlic, thyme, rosemary, zest, salt/pepper.
2. Loosen skin; rub butter mix under skin. Rub oil/salt/pepper outside. Stuff lemon inside.
3. Roast 1 hour (basting halfway) to 165°F thigh temp. Rest 15 min.

ingredients:
2 lb Yukon Gold potatoes, sliced
1 cup Cream
1.5 TBSP butter 
1 tsp Salt and pepper
steps:
1. Boil potatoes in salted water 20 min. Drain; dry in pot 1-2 min. Then rice.
2. Warm cream and butter in pot. Add to potatoes along with salt, pepper.

ingredients:
1 1/2 cups warm water
1 cup sourdough starter
1/2 cup corn oil
1/2 cup sugar
1 1/2 tsp salt
6 cups bread flour
steps:
1. Mix water, starter, oil, sugar, salt. Sift in flour. Rise overnight in oiled bowl.
2. Divide in half; place in 2 loaf pans. Knead/shape if needed. Rise until doubled (2-4 hrs).
3. Bake 350°F for 40-45 min until hollow sounding.

ingredients:
2 tbsp butter
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, sliced
2 celery stalks, sliced
3 cloves garlic, minced
8 cups chicken stock
1/2 tsp dried thyme (or 1 tbsp fresh)
1 tsp turmeric (optional)
3 cups cooked chicken, chopped
3 cups wide egg noodles
1/2 cup heavy cream (optional)
steps:
1. Sauté onion, carrots, celery in butter/oil 5 min. Add garlic.
2. Add stock, thyme, turmeric, salt/pepper. Boil, then simmer 10 min.
3. Add noodles and chicken. Cook 8-10 min until noodles tender. Stir in cream.

ingredients:
1 bag salad mix (Romaine/Iceberg)
1/2 cup croutons
2 tomatoes, quartered
1/4 cup black olives
4 pepperoncini peppers
1/4 cup red onion, sliced
1/4 cup Parmesan cheese
DRESSING: 1/2 cup mayo, 1/4 cup white vinegar, 2 tbsp oil, 2 tbsp corn syrup, garlic powder, Italian seasoning
steps:
1. Whisk dressing ingredients (mayo, vinegar, oil, syrup, spices). Chill.
2. Toss salad ingredients in a large bowl.
3. Serve with dressing on the side or tossed.

ingredients:
4 cups all-purpose flour
2 tsp sugar
2 tsp salt
2 1/4 tsp instant yeast
2 cups warm water
1 tbsp butter (for greasing)
steps:
1. Mix flour, sugar, salt, yeast. Stir in warm water to form sticky dough.
2. Cover measure; rise 1.5 hr or until doubled.
3. Deflate. Divide into 2 buttered Pyrex bowls. Rise 20-30 min.
4. Bake at 425°F for 15 min, then 375°F for 15-20 min until golden.

ingredients:
8 flour tortillas
3 cups cooked chicken, shredded
2 cups shredded cheddar/jack cheese
1 (15 oz) can enchilada sauce
1 (4 oz) can green chilies
1/2 cup sour cream
Cilantro
steps:
1. Mix chicken, 1 cup cheese, green chilies, sour cream.
2. Fill tortillas, roll, place in baking dish.
3. Pour enchilada sauce over rolls; top with remaining cheese.
4. Bake 20-25 min at 350°F until bubbly.

ingredients:
10 corn tortillas
1 tbsp vegetable oil (spray or brush)
1 tsp salt
Lime juice (optional)
steps:
1. Cut tortillas into wedges.
2. Spray or brush with oil; toss with salt and lime juice.
3. spread on baking sheet. Bake at 350°F for 10-15 min, turning halfway, until crisp.

ingredients:
1.5 lb chicken breast, bite-sized
1/4 cup cornstarch
2 tbsp oil
SAUCE: 1/2 cup soy sauce, 1/4 cup water, 3 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tsp ginger, 1 tsp garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar
steps:
1. Toss chicken in cornstarch. Fry in oil until brown/cooked.
2. Whisk sauce ingredients. Pour into pan with chicken.
3. Simmer until sauce thickens and coats chicken.

ingredients:
1/2 cup orzo pasta
1/2 cup white rice
2 tbsp butter
1/2 cup diced onion
2 cloves garlic, minced
2 cups chicken broth
steps:
1. Melt butter. Sauté orzo and onion until golden. Add garlic.
2. Stir in rice and chicken broth. Bring to boil.
3. Cover, reduce heat to low, simmer 20 min. Fluff with fork.

ingredients:
2 lb broccoli florets
3 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp kosher salt
1/2 tsp black pepper
2 tsp lemon juice (optional)
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425°F. Toss broccoli with oil, salt, pepper.
2. Roast 16–18 minutes, tossing once, until edges are browned.

ingredients:
1.5 lb ground beef
1 egg, beaten
1 onion, chopped
1 cup cheddar cheese
1/2 cup carrot, chopped
2/3 cup milk
3 slices bread, crumbled
2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp pepper
GLAZE: 1/4 cup ketchup, 1/4 cup brown sugar, 1 tbsp mustard
steps:
1. Mix beef, egg, onion, cheese, carrot, milk, crumbs, spices. Form loaf.
2. Mix glaze ingredients. Spread over loaf.
3. Bake at 350°F for 1 hour.

ingredients:
1 lb carrots, peeled and sliced/halved
1 tbsp olive oil
1/2 tsp garlic salt
1/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese
steps:
1. Toss carrots with oil and garlic salt.
2. Roast at 400°F for 20 minutes.
3. Sprinkle with Parmesan. Roast 5-10 min until tender/crisp.

ingredients:
3-4 lb chuck roast
1 packet Ranch dressing mix
1 packet Italian dressing mix
1 packet Brown Gravy mix
1/2 cup water
1 onion, sliced
steps:
1. Place roast and onion in slow cooker.
2. Mix Ranch, Italian, and Gravy packets with water. Pour over roast.
3. Cook on Low for 8-10 hours until tender.

ingredients:
2.5 lb potatoes (Yukon/Red), cubed
1/3 cup olive oil
1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp pepper
2 tsp dried herbs (basil/oregano/thyme)
1 tsp garlic powder
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 475°F.
2. Toss potatoes with oil and all seasonings until coated.
3. Roast in single layer 20-30 min, turning once, until crispy and tender.

ingredients:
2 lb carrots, peeled and sliced
1/4 cup butter
1/4 cup brown sugar
1/4 cup Bourbon (or orange juice)
1/2 tsp salt, pinch cayenne
steps:
1. Simmer carrots in salted water until just tender; drain.
2. Melt butter in pan; add sugar, liquid, salt, cayenne.
3. Toss carrots in glaze; cook 5 min until glazed and shiny.

ingredients:
2.5-3 lb Tri-Tip roast
RUB: 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp pepper, 2 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp brown sugar
steps:
1. Mix rub ingredients. Season roast thoroughly.
2. Heat smoker to 225°F. Smoke until internal temp 130°F (approx 60-90 min).
3. Optional: Sear 1-2 min per side in hot skillet. Rest 15 min slice against grain.

ingredients:
7 cups all-purpose flour
2.5 cups warm milk
1/2 cup sugar
1/2 cup butter, softened
2 eggs
2 tsp salt
4 tsp yeast
steps:
1. Dissolve yeast in warm milk/sugar. Mix with butter, eggs, salt, flour. Knead smooth. Rise 1 hr.
2. Shape into 24 rolls. Place on sheet. Rise 30 min.
3. Bake 350°F 15-20 min. Brush with melted butter.

ingredients:
8 slices rye bread
1 lb sliced corned beef
1 cup sauerkraut, drained well
8 slices Swiss cheese
1/2 cup Russian Dressing (Mayo, Ketchup, relish, horseradish)
Butter for grilling
steps:
1. Butter one side of bread. Spread dressing on unbuttered side.
2. Layer Swiss, corned beef, sauerkraut, Swiss. Top with bread.
3. Grill in skillet 3-4 min/side until golden and melted.

ingredients:
4 Russet potatoes
Oil for frying
Salt
steps:
1. Slice potatoes thin. Soak in cold water (optional salt soak 30 min). Dry thoroughly.
2. Heat oil to 365°F. Fry in batches until golden crisp.
3. Drain on rack/paper towel. Salt immediately.

ingredients:
1 head cabbage, finely chopped (8 cups)
1/4 cup shredded carrot
DRESSING: 1/2 cup mayo, 1/3 cup sugar, 1/4 cup milk, 1/4 cup buttermilk, 2.5 tbsp lemon juice, 1.5 tbsp vinegar, salt/pepper
steps:
1. Whisk dressing ingredients until smooth.
2. Toss with cabbage and carrots.
3. Chill at least 2 hours before serving.

ingredients:
4 lb pork shoulder roast
1 cup BBQ sauce
1/2 cup cider vinegar
1/2 cup chicken broth
1/4 cup brown sugar
1 tbsp mustard, 1 tbsp chili powder, 1.5 tsp thyme
1 onion chopped, 2 cloves garlic
steps:
1. Place pork in slow cooker.
2. Mix all other ingredients; pour over pork.
3. Cook Low 8-10 hours. Shred and serve on buns.

ingredients:
4-5 cucumbers, sliced
2 onions, sliced
BRINE: 1 1/3 cup sugar, 1 cup vinegar, 2 tbsp salt
steps:
1. Pack cucumbers and onions into jars.
2. Whisk sugar, vinegar, and salt until dissolved (or heat and cool).
3. Pour over cucumbers. Refrigerate 24 hours.

ingredients:
1 lb thick-cut bacon
8 slices sourdough/country bread, toasted
1/2 cup mayonnaise
2 large tomatoes, sliced
Salt & Pepper
Lettuce leaves
steps:
1. Bake bacon on rack at 400°F 15-20 min until crisp.
2. Spread mayo on toast.
3. Layer lettuce, seasoned tomato slices, and generous bacon. Slice and serve.

ingredients: 1 family-size bag potato chips
steps: 1. Open bag and serve in a bowl.

ingredients:
2.5 lb mixed fruit (berries, melon, grapes)
Juice of 1/2 lemon (optional)
steps: 1. Cube/slice fruit and toss gently with lemon juice.

ingredients:
1 tbsp oil
1 onion, diced
2 (4-oz) cans diced green chiles
2 tsp cumin
1 tsp oregano
6 cups chicken broth
3 cups shredded cooked chicken
3 (15-oz) cans white beans, rinsed
1/2 cup sour cream
1/2 cup half-and-half (or milk)
Salt & pepper
steps:
1. Sauté onion in oil; brown beef with chili powder, cumin, salt.
2. Stir in crushed tomatoes and beans; simmer gently 30–45 minutes; adjust seasoning.

ingredients:
2 boxes cornbread mix (8.5 oz each)
Ingredients per package (usually eggs & milk)
steps: 1. Prepare batter per package. Bake in 9x13 pan 18–22 minutes.

ingredients:
2 lb 80/20 ground beef
5 hamburger buns
5 slices cheddar or American cheese
1 tsp kosher salt
1/2 tsp black pepper
Oil for grill or skillet
steps:
1. Form 5 patties; season with salt & pepper.
2. Cook on hot grill/skillet 3–4 min/side to desired doneness (160°F for well‑done).
3. Add cheese to melt; serve on buns.

ingredients:
10 hot dogs
10 hot dog buns
Condiments (ketchup, mustard, relish)
steps:
1. Grill or boil hot dogs 5–8 minutes.
2. Serve in buns with condiments.

ingredients:
2 (28-oz) cans baked beans
2 tbsp brown sugar (optional)
1 tbsp mustard (optional)
steps: 1. Bake beans at 350°F until bubbly, 20–25 minutes; stir in sugar/mustard if desired.

ingredients:
2.5 lb Yukon gold potatoes, 1-inch cubes
3/4 cup mayonnaise
2 tbsp mustard
1/2 cup chopped celery
1/4 cup chopped red onion
1 tsp kosher salt
1/2 tsp pepper
steps:
1. Boil potatoes until tender; drain and cool.
2. Toss with remaining ingredients; chill.

ingredients:
3.5 lb pork shoulder
1 tbsp kosher salt
1 tbsp chili powder
1 tsp cumin
1 tsp oregano
1 cup orange juice
15 small corn tortillas
steps:
1. Season pork and slow cook on LOW ~8 hours with orange juice.
2. Shred; crisp edges in a hot skillet if desired. Serve on warmed tortillas.

ingredients:
4 cups frozen corn
1 tbsp butter
2 tbsp mayonnaise
2 tbsp sour cream
1/2 tsp chili powder
1/2 tsp kosher salt
2 tbsp chopped cilantro
1 tbsp lime juice
1/4 cup crumbled cotija (optional)
steps:
1. Sauté corn in butter until lightly charred.
2. Off heat, stir in mayo, sour cream, chili powder, salt, cilantro, and lime. Top with cotija.

ingredients:
3 (15-oz) cans black beans, drained & rinsed
1/2 cup salsa
1 tsp cumin
1/2 tsp garlic powder
1/2 tsp kosher salt
steps:
1. Rinse beans. Combine with salsa, cumin, garlic powder, and salt; simmer 8–10 minutes.
2. Mash a few beans to thicken if desired.

ingredients:
10 eggs
2 tbsp butter
1/2 tsp kosher salt
Black pepper, to taste
steps: 1. Cook eggs in butter over medium-low heat to desired doneness; season with salt and pepper.

ingredients:
3 cups pancake mix (complete)
2 1/4 cups water
Butter or oil for griddle
Maple syrup, to serve
steps:
1. Mix batter per package; rest 2 minutes.
2. Cook pancakes on greased griddle 2–3 minutes per side.

ingredients: 1 lb thick-cut bacon
steps: 1. Bake on a rack over a sheet pan at 400°F for 16–20 minutes.

ingredients:
10 flour tortillas (8-inch)
3 cups shredded cheese (Monterey Jack/cheddar)
Oil or butter for skillet
steps:
1. Heat tortilla in lightly oiled skillet; sprinkle cheese; top with another tortilla.
2. Cook 2–3 minutes per side until golden and melted; cut into wedges.

ingredients: 2 cups salsa (jarred)
steps: 1. Serve salsa in bowls with chips; optionally stir in lime juice and cilantro.

ingredients: 5 ripe avocados, mashed with lime & salt
steps:
1. Mash avocados with 2 tbsp lime juice and 1 tsp salt.
2. Optional: add 1/4 cup diced onion and cilantro.

ingredients:
10 eggs
1 cup prepared chile verde (jarred)
1 cup shredded Monterey Jack cheese
2 tbsp butter
Salt & pepper
steps:
1. Whisk eggs with salt and pepper. Melt butter in nonstick skillet.
2. Cook omelets in batches: add eggs, sprinkle cheese, fold, and top with warm chile verde.

ingredients:
10 slices sandwich bread
10 slices cheddar or American cheese
4 tbsp softened butter
steps:
1. Butter bread; sandwich cheese between slices.
2. Cook in skillet over medium heat until golden and melty, 2–3 minutes per side.

ingredients:
2 (32-oz) cartons tomato soup (or 4 cans condensed + milk)
1/2 cup cream or milk (optional)
steps: 1. Heat soup in saucepan; stir in cream to taste.

ingredients:
2 lb large shrimp, peeled & deveined
1 lb mixed stir-fry vegetables
3 tbsp soy sauce
2 tbsp oyster sauce (or teriyaki)
2 tbsp oil
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp grated ginger (optional)
steps:
1. Stir-fry shrimp in hot oil 2–3 minutes; remove.
2. Sauté vegetables 3–4 minutes; add sauces and shrimp; toss until hot.

ingredients:
2 lb frozen edamame in pods
1 tbsp kosher salt (for water)
Flaky salt to finish
steps: 1. Boil edamame 4–5 minutes. Drain and sprinkle with flaky salt.

ingredients:
5 cups cooked, chilled rice
1 lb mixed frozen vegetables
4 eggs, beaten
3 tbsp soy sauce
2 tbsp oil
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp sesame oil (optional)
steps:
1. Heat oil; scramble eggs softly and set aside.
2. Sauté garlic and vegetables 3–4 minutes; add rice and soy sauce; stir-fry until hot.
3. Stir in eggs; finish with sesame oil.

ingredients:
1.5 lb mixed vegetables (frozen blend)
1/2 tsp kosher salt
1 tbsp butter (optional)
steps: 1. Steam or microwave veggies until tender; season with salt and butter.

ingredients:
5 eggs
2 tbsp butter
1/2 tsp kosher salt
Black pepper, to taste
steps: 1. Cook eggs in butter over medium-low heat to desired doneness; season with salt and pepper.

ingredients:
10 thick slices bread (brioche/texas toast)
6 eggs
1 1/4 cups milk
2 tbsp sugar
1 tsp vanilla
1/2 tsp cinnamon
Butter for griddle
steps:
1. Whisk eggs, milk, sugar, vanilla, cinnamon.
2. Dip bread and cook on buttered griddle 2–3 minutes per side.

ingredients:
2.5 lb mahi-mahi fillets
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp kosher salt
1/2 tsp pepper
Lemon wedges
steps:
1. Heat and oil grill. Pat fillets dry; oil and season.
2. Grill 3–4 minutes/side until opaque and flakes easily (130–135°F).

ingredients:
5 ears corn, husked
Butter, salt (to serve)
steps: 1. Boil corn 6–8 minutes until tender. Serve with butter and salt.

ingredients:
1.5 lb cod fillets
1/3 cup mayonnaise (or buttermilk)
1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese
1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs
1 tsp dried parsley, 1/2 tsp paprika, salt/pepper
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F. Line baking sheet with foil.
2. Mix Parmesan, panko, parsley, paprika in a bowl.
3. Brush cod with mayo (or dip in buttermilk); press into crumb mixture.
4. Bake 15-20 min until fish flakes easily.

ingredients:
8 oz smoked salmon
8 oz cream cheese, softened
1 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tbsp fresh dill
1 cucumber, sliced
Crackers or baguette slices
Capers, red onion (optional)
steps:
1. Mix cream cheese with lemon juice and dill.
2. Spread on cucumber slices or crackers.
3. Top with smoked salmon and garnish with capers/onion.

ingredients:
1 bunch asparagus, trimmed
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tbsp grated Parmesan cheese
1 tsp garlic powder, salt, pepper
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F.
2. Toss asparagus with oil, garlic powder, salt, pepper.
3. Roast 10-12 min. Sprinkle with Parmesan before serving.

ingredients:
1 cup long-grain white rice
2 cups chicken broth
2 tbsp butter
1/2 cup diced onion
1 clove garlic, minced
steps:
1. Melt butter. Sauté onion until tender. Add rice; cook/stir 2 min to toast.
2. Add broth and garlic. Bring to boil.
3. Cover, reduce heat to low, simmer 15-18 min. Rest 5 min. Fluff.

ingredients:
1.5 lb salmon fillet
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tbsp lemon juice
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped
Salt & Pepper
steps:
1. Whisk oil, lemon juice, garlic, parsley, salt, pepper.
2. Place salmon on foil-lined sheet. Pour marinade over salmon.
3. Bake at 375°F for 15-18 minutes until flaky.

ingredients:
2 lb sweet potatoes, peeled and cubed
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp pepper
1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp thyme
1/2 tsp paprika
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425°F.
2. Toss sweet potatoes with oil and spices until coated.
3. Roast 30-35 min, tossing halfway, until tender and caramelized.

ingredients:
5 cups mixed greens (or arugula/spinach)
1 cucumber, sliced
1/2 red onion, sliced
DRESSING: 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp lemon juice (or vinegar), 1 tsp dried basil, salt/pepper
steps:
1. Whisk dressing ingredients together.
2. Toss greens and vegetables in a large bowl.
3. Drizzle with dressing and toss to coat.

ingredients:
1 lb shrimp, peeled/deveined
1 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1/2 tsp garlic powder
8 corn tortillas
SLAW: 2 cups cabbage mix, 2 tbsp lime juice, 1 tbsp mayo
Avocado, Cilantro
steps:
1. Toss shrimp with spices. Sauté in oil 3-4 min until pink.
2. Mix slaw ingredients. Chill slightly.
3. Assemble tacos with shrimp, slaw, cilantro, and avocado.

ingredients:
4 cups shredded cabbage
1/2 cup cilantro, chopped
1/4 cup red onion, diced
1 jalapeño, minced
DRESSING: 2 tbsp lime juice, 1 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 tsp cumin, salt
steps:
1. Whisk dressing ingredients.
2. Toss with cabbage, cilantro, onion, jalapeño.
3. Chill 20 min to blend flavors.

ingredients:
1 cup sour cream (or Mexican Crema)
2 tbsp lime juice
1 tsp lime zest
1/4 tsp garlic powder
Pinch of salt
steps:
1. Whisk all ingredients in a small bowl until smooth.
2. Chill until ready to serve.
